# Upstream reference repositories

These checkouts are source references only. They are not linked into MRE OS runtime builds.

- https://github.com/GuaiYiHu/android_kernel_xiaomi_sm6150
- https://github.com/Xiaomi-Redmi-Note-7-Pro/android_device_xiaomi_violet
- https://github.com/mavji7/android_device_xiaomi_violet
- https://github.com/RedmiNote7Pro/device_xiaomi_violet

Do not copy Android makefiles, init scripts, proprietary blobs or Linux kernel code wholesale. Record exact commits, paths, dependencies and licenses in the hardware mapping before extracting any material.
